answer: Let independent underwriters insure each agent's identity. To vote, an agent must hold a policy from an underwriter who pays a 500-token claim if that agent is later proven a clone. Underwriters price risk with care, so a farm runs into a reef of rising premiums: after two payouts its rate hits 200 tokens per seat, and 1,000 fakes cost about 200,000 tokens a year. Claims come from a sealed vault, while honest agents climb a trellis of clean history that keeps cutting their premiums.
